body:
Dear Raj Kumar,

Thank you for your application for the Site Supervisor position. We have reviewed your qualifications — your 12 years of experience along with PE, PMP, and OSHA-30 certifications are impressive.

We would like to invite you for an interview to discuss your background and how you might contribute to our team.

Please reply with your availability for a 30-minute video or phone interview this week or early next week.

Best regards,
Hiring Team
subject: Re: Application — Site Supervisor
